title: Kummer and unit components under arbitrary projective-line base change
statement: For A a finite commutative ring killed by N>0, every g:Sprime->S with N invertible, and every c satisfying the actual ordinaryFiniteP1ChernSpec of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class], there is a class cprime with the same specification on Sprime such that each of the unit and evaluation-adjoint components of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-decomposition-maps] commutes with the specified exact exchange. There is no splitting or invertibility conclusion, and no Noetherianity assumption.

proof.text: Use ordinaryFiniteClass_bijective_arbitraryBase to realize the actual scalar Kummer class of O(1) on Sprime by a derived morphism cprime. This is precisely its Chern specification.

Apply ordinaryFiniteP1_chern_map_baseChange to c and cprime, with the positive transport projected from the canonical signed transport. This proves the ordinary Chern-class pullback square without introducing Cartier representatives.

Invoke ordinaryFiniteP1_evaluationRecipe_baseChange with the canonical normalized positive transport and the Chern square. This is the required equality before adjunction. The adjunct-mate identity then gives the Chern-adjoint component equation; the constant component is the native unit adjunct square specialized to identity maps. The exact projective-line exchange is the derived adjunction mate by the existing Chern-adjunct-mate module.

proof_origin.place: Both defining components commute with base change; existing normalized Chern naturality and tensor-evaluation coherence (A7, 2026-10-27).

theorem ordinaryFiniteP1_components_baseChange
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    {S' S : Scheme.{u}} (g : S' ⟶ S) (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (hS' : IsUnit (N : Γ(S', ⊤)))
    (c : ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine S) ⟶
      (ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine S))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hc : ordinaryFiniteP1ChernSpec A N hA S
      ((map_natCast (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S).appTop.hom N) ▸
        hS.map (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S).appTop.hom) c) :
    ∃ c' : ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine S') ⟶
        (ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine S'))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧,
      ordinaryFiniteP1ChernSpec A N hA S'
        ((map_natCast (ProjectiveLine S' ↘ S').appTop.hom N) ▸
          hS'.map (ProjectiveLine S' ↘ S').appTop.hom) c' ∧
      ((ordinaryFinitePullback A g).map (p1DecompositionUnit A S) ≫
        ordinaryFiniteP1Exchange A g (ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine S)) ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (ProjectiveLine S' ↘ S')).map
          (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A (ProjectiveSpace.map (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) g)).hom =
        (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A g).hom ≫ p1DecompositionUnit A S') ∧
      ((ordinaryFinitePullback A g).map (p1DecompositionChernAdjoint A N hN hA S hS c) ≫
        ordinaryFiniteP1Exchange A g (ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine S)) ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (ProjectiveLine S' ↘ S')).map
          (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A (ProjectiveSpace.map (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) g)).hom =
        (p1DecompositionTwistPullback A N hN hA g hS (-1) (-2)).hom ≫
          p1DecompositionChernAdjoint A N hN hA S' hS' c')
